sessions.title: eBPF Observability for Platform Teams
sessions.speaker: Mina Park
sessions.abstract: Live-debug a noisy neighbor with Cilium Hubble and eBPF. How platform teams ship OpenTelemetry-grade signals without sidecars.

crowdTakes.author: Priya Shah
crowdTakes.take: Standing room. Sit along the back wall — Hubble demo is live right now.

crowdTakes.author: Chris Okonkwo
crowdTakes.take: They just showed dropping sidecars. If you care about eBPF, do not skip this.

sessions.title: OpenTelemetry from Zero to Production
sessions.speaker: Elena Voss
sessions.abstract: A no-slide-ware path: auto-instrument a Kubernetes service, sample traces, and get a useful dashboard before the coffee gets cold.

crowdTakes.author: Jonah Reed
crowdTakes.take: Room is filling early. Grab an aisle seat if you want to see the collector config.

sessions.title: Multi-cluster GitOps at Scale
sessions.speaker: Aisha Rahman
sessions.abstract: One repo, forty clusters, zero snowflake YAML. Promotion gates, drift, and what actually breaks when you add a second region.

crowdTakes.author: Sam Ortiz
crowdTakes.take: They posted the GitOps promotion diagram in the hallway. Worth the climb to L3.

sessions.title: Platform Engineering Office Hours
sessions.speaker: Jordan Kim
sessions.abstract: Bring a golden-path war story. Facilitated office hours for people who own the paved road, not just walk it.

crowdTakes.author: Riley Chen
crowdTakes.take: Small room, good questions. They are talking IDP scorecards, not product pitches.

sessions.title: The State of Cloud Native 2026
sessions.speaker: CNCF TOC
sessions.abstract: Annual state of the union: project graduations, WASM, and why platform engineering is no longer a side quest.

crowdTakes.author: Dee Patel
crowdTakes.take: Hall A is packed. Overflow screens in Hall B if you just need the talk.

sessions.title: WASM on Kubernetes Without the Hype
sessions.speaker: Noah Blake
sessions.abstract: What spin, wasmCloud, and containerd-wasmshims can actually run in a cluster this year — and what still cannot.

crowdTakes.author: Priya Shah
crowdTakes.take: Half the room is here for cold-start numbers. They have them.

sessions.title: Helm Charts That Don't Haunt You
sessions.speaker: Luis Mendes
sessions.abstract: Values files, library charts, and the three tests that stop a 2am rollback. Directly under the 255 talk.

crowdTakes.author: Chris Okonkwo
crowdTakes.take: Fine intro. If you already ship charts, go upstairs to 255 instead.

sessions.title: Running LLMs on Kubernetes
sessions.speaker: Hana Ito
sessions.abstract: Gang scheduling, KV-cache, and not lighting your GPU nodes on fire. A practical inference stack.

crowdTakes.author: Dee Patel
crowdTakes.take: GPU talk, GPU crowd. Line for the door already.

sessions.title: Cost Optimization Without Shame
sessions.speaker: Maya Solano
sessions.abstract: Show finance the unit cost of a golden path. Rightsizing that platform teams will actually keep.

crowdTakes.author: Riley Chen
crowdTakes.take: Less spreadsheet, more 'here is what idle nodes cost us last Tuesday.'

sessions.title: Securing the Supply Chain with Sigstore
sessions.speaker: Pat Nguyen
sessions.abstract: Keyless signing, provenance, and policy that does not page you because someone rebuilt a base image.

crowdTakes.author: Sam Ortiz
crowdTakes.take: Good if you own the pipeline. Skip if you only consume images.

sessions.title: CNCF Project Lightning Talks
sessions.speaker: Various
sessions.abstract: Five-minute pitches from maintainers. Sit near a power outlet; this is a snack-and-wander slot.

crowdTakes.author: Jonah Reed
crowdTakes.take: Hall B is loud. Fine for grazing, bad for taking notes.

sessions.title: Service Mesh: Do You Even Need One?
sessions.speaker: Gita Narayanan
sessions.abstract: A decision talk, not a feature dump. Sidecar vs sidecarless, and when Gateway API is enough.

crowdTakes.author: Chris Okonkwo
crowdTakes.take: They started with 'maybe you don't.' Refreshing. Room 354, L3.
